transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. As we approach the final production approval on Friday afternoon, I need to run our standard round-robin preflight review on the Mara Chen retrospective catalog. The current package includes the print catalog, a downloadable digital edition, several archival photographs, and a sponsor acknowledgment. I'd like to go through each area systematically — archive, rights, accessibility, and sponsor leads — so we can flag any issues before I sign off. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a serious issue I found this morning. I located the signed lender agreement for the Mara Chen archive in the archive file, and it imposes two hard constraints we haven't reflected in the production brief yet: first, the festival may print no more than 300 copies of the catalog; second, the supplied archive photographs may not be reproduced in the downloadable digital edition. Both of these directly conflict with our current package as described — the digital edition currently includes archival photographs, and we haven't set a print cap at 300 copies. I haven't yet updated the production brief, but we need to address this before Friday's approval.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a rights issue. I confirmed by email yesterday that the photograph credit must read exactly 'Mara Chen Estate / Northline Photos,' and the photograph currently planned for the cover may appear only inside the catalog, not on its cover. I haven't entered this confirmation in the rights register yet, so it wouldn't show up in a routine check. We need to update the cover design and ensure the credit line is exact before Friday's approval.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag two accessibility requirements from my test. First, the digital edition must be delivered as a tagged PDF. Second, every catalog image needs approved alt text of no more than 150 characters. My test report is still awaiting attachment to the delivery checklist, so these requirements wouldn't surface in a routine review yet. We need to ensure both are addressed before Friday's approval.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a sponsor contract issue. I confirmed in the sponsor contract that the sponsor logo may not appear beside Mara Chen's name or portrait, and the acknowledgment must appear on the final page with the exact wording 'Supported by Northstar Cultural Fund.' The signed clause has not yet been circulated to the design team, so they wouldn't be aware of these constraints in a routine review. We need to verify the current design complies and circulate this clause before Friday's approval.
transcript.speaker: A5

commitments.detail: Set print cap at 300 copies and remove archival photographs from the downloadable digital edition per lender agreement.
Enter exact photo credit 'Mara Chen Estate / Northline Photos' in the rights register and move cover photograph to inside the catalog only.
Attach test report to delivery checklist confirming tagged PDF requirement and alt text max 150 characters for all images.
Circulate signed sponsor clause to design team: no logo beside Mara Chen's name or portrait; acknowledgment on final page with exact wording 'Supported by Northstar Cultural Fund.'
